epic.name: Redesign the request list as a batch listing
unverifiedAssumptions: Verify the total value figure against a real batch: the app adds every request's amount into one total, treating them all as the same currency and the same direction of money. If a real batch mixes currencies, or mixes money-in with money-out rows, the headline total will be a number that does not mean anything — and it will look perfectly plausible.

Verify the awaiting/decided split against a real batch: the app treats a request as decided whenever its status is anything other than Imported. If the service ever sends a third status that does not mean 'decided', those requests will be counted as decided and the outstanding count — the number the whole screen is built around — will read low.
